profile.summary: diomed is a Mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Moment.js's localization system, particularly for Croatian and Serbian language support. Their contributions focus on ensuring accurate date formatting and cultural conventions in regional locales, demonstrating deep knowledge of internationalization patterns and Unicode handling. While their work is confined to library maintenance and localization quality improvements, their attention to detail and cultural sensitivity in language-specific formatting suggests strong problem-solving skills in niche technical areas. No evidence exists of frontend/backend frameworks or modern JavaScript features in their contributions.
